id: 17_LMG Laser Safety Video Laser System Power Can Kill! Under the hood of a Rofin Si
title: 激光系统的电能可致命：谐振腔内部
source_doc: course/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/17_LMG Laser Safety Video Laser System Power Can Kill! Under the hood of a Rofin Si.md
author_source: project/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/17_LMG Laser Safety Video Laser System Power Can Kill! Under the hood of a Rofin Si/src.py

points.K2: 开盖联锁：一开就断高压
points.K5: 短接联锁，人站外面开机
points.K7: 护罩加门联锁，两道保护
points.K12: 演示只为说明原理和防护

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台大机柜旁，旁边一个闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a large laser cabinet with a lightning bolt icon nearby.
shots.narration: 激光器里的电，是能要命的。
overlay: 激光系统的电能可致命：谐振腔内部

shots.scene: 机柜、联锁开关、闪电、紫色光四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a laser cabinet, an interlock switch, a lightning bolt and a purple glow. No people.
shots.narration: 跟老李掀开谐振腔看一看。

shots.scene: 老李站在一台工业二氧化碳激光器谐振腔旁
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands beside the resonator cabinet of an industrial carbon dioxide laser.
shots.narration: 老李是做激光维修的。

shots.scene: 老李把手放在谐振腔顶盖上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer rests his hand on the top cover of the resonator.
shots.narration: 今天他要讲讲高压电的安全。

shots.scene: 机柜外壳上的黄色三角高压警告标志特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a yellow triangular high voltage warning sign on the outside of the laser cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 外壳上贴着“危险 高压”的警示贴。

shots.scene: 老李指着警示贴
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer points at the high voltage warning sign.
shots.narration: 老李先指给我们看这一张。

shots.section_title: 开盖联锁：一开就断高压
shots.scene: 顶盖被掀起，里面是一排放电管和导线
shots.prompt_en: The top cover is lifted, revealing a row of discharge tubes and wires inside. No people.
shots.narration: 顶盖一打开，
overlay: 开盖联锁：一开就断高压

shots.section_title: 开盖联锁：一开就断高压
shots.scene: 示意图：顶盖掀开，联锁开关的插销脱出
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: as the cover lifts, a latch pulls out of the interlock switch. No people.
shots.narration: 联锁开关的插销就脱出来了。

shots.section_title: 开盖联锁：一开就断高压
shots.scene: 示意图：高压线路图标变暗，闪电消失
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: the high voltage circuit icons go dark and the lightning bolts disappear. No people.
shots.narration: 里面的高压，全部切断。

shots.scene: 机柜里的小风扇还在转，旁边一个小闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: Inside the cabinet, a small cooling fan keeps spinning, with a small lightning bolt icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 高压断了，风扇这些还带着市电。

shots.scene: 老李指着风扇
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer points at the spinning fan inside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 它们还在转着。

shots.scene: 放电管两端的黄铜接头，带闪电符号
shots.prompt_en: Brass fittings at both ends of the discharge tubes, marked with lightning bolt symbols. No people.
shots.narration: 看放电管两端这些黄铜部件。

shots.scene: 黄铜接头旁一个大大的闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: A large lightning bolt icon next to the brass fittings. No people.
shots.narration: 开机以后，这里有上万伏高压。

shots.section_title: 短接联锁，人站外面开机
shots.scene: 联锁开关图标被接通，旁边一个开机按钮
shots.prompt_en: An interlock switch icon shown as closed, next to a power-on button. No people.
shots.narration: 老李要把联锁接上，开机演示。
overlay: 短接联锁，人站外面开机

shots.section_title: 短接联锁，人站外面开机
shots.scene: 老李退后，站在开口外面
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer steps back and stands outside the open cabinet.
shots.narration: 人站在外面，把光开起来。

shots.scene: 满功率的电流表指针打到头
shots.prompt_en: An ammeter needle swings all the way to full scale. No people.
shots.narration: 满功率的时候，电流非常大。

shots.scene: 一根细小的电流箭头指向心脏图标
shots.prompt_en: A thin small current arrow pointing to a heart icon. No people.
shots.narration: 而让人致命的电流和电压，都很小。

shots.scene: 老李转身面对镜头，表情严肃
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer turns to face the camera with a serious look.
shots.narration: 这里的电，远远超过致命的量。

shots.section_title: 护罩加门联锁，两道保护
shots.scene: 手伸进开口的图标，旁边一个大闪电
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand reaching into the open cabinet, with a big lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 要是伸手进去，就会出大事。
overlay: 护罩加门联锁，两道保护

shots.section_title: 护罩加门联锁，两道保护
shots.scene: 开口处罩着带警示贴的塑料护罩
shots.prompt_en: A plastic cover with warning stickers sits over the opening. No people.
shots.narration: 平时，这里有带警示的塑料护罩。

shots.section_title: 护罩加门联锁，两道保护
shots.scene: 老李扶着顶盖，指向门联锁
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds the top cover and points at the door interlock.
shots.narration: 还有门联锁，两道保护。

shots.section_title: 护罩加门联锁，两道保护
shots.scene: 盾牌图标挡住闪电
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon blocking a lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 不会一不小心伸进去被电到。

shots.scene: 放电管里亮起淡紫色的辉光
shots.prompt_en: A soft purple glow lights up inside the discharge tubes. No people.
shots.narration: 开机了，看放电管里的紫色辉光。

shots.scene: 气体分子发光的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of gas molecules glowing as electricity passes through them. No people.
shots.narration: 这是气体在放电。

shots.scene: 一个小电流表指针微微抬起
shots.prompt_en: A small ammeter needle lifts slightly. No people.
shots.narration: 这时管里已经有很小的电流了。

shots.scene: 紫色辉光变得更亮
shots.prompt_en: The purple glow in the tubes becomes brighter. No people.
shots.narration: 加大功率，辉光更亮。

shots.scene: 看不见的光束：一条虚线和一只闭着的眼睛
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of an invisible beam as a dotted line, next to a closed eye icon. No people.
shots.narration: 真正的激光在红外，眼睛看不见。

shots.scene: 控制面板上的功率显示数字跳动
shots.prompt_en: A power display on the control panel with changing blank digits. No people.
shots.narration: 只能看功率显示。

shots.scene: 从侧面斜着看放电管
shots.prompt_en: An angled side view into the discharge tubes with the purple glow. No people.
shots.narration: 从侧面斜着看，

shots.scene: 电极处放电，新鲜气体流过的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: discharge collecting at the electrodes while fresh gas flows through the tube. No people.
shots.narration: 能看到电极处的放电和流过的气体。

shots.scene: 开口平面画一道虚线，手停在线外
shots.prompt_en: A dotted line drawn across the plane of the opening, with a hand stopping outside it. No people.
shots.narration: 我们绝不越过这个平面。

shots.scene: 机柜里一排闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: Lightning bolt icons inside the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 里面是上万伏的高压。

shots.scene: 水汽图标里，一道电弧跳向人形图标
shots.prompt_en: Water vapor droplets in the air, with an arc jumping toward a person icon. No people.
shots.narration: 空气潮湿时，高压还可能跳到人身上。

shots.section_title: 演示只为说明原理和防护
shots.scene: 老李站在开口旁对镜头讲话
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands beside the open cabinet and talks to the camera.
shots.narration: 这一段只是为了演示。
overlay: 演示只为说明原理和防护

shots.section_title: 演示只为说明原理和防护
shots.scene: 激光产生的原理示意：放电、气体、镜子
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of how a laser beam is generated: discharge, gas and mirrors. No people.
shots.narration: 让大家看到激光是怎么产生的，

shots.section_title: 演示只为说明原理和防护
shots.scene: 警示贴、护罩、联锁三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a warning sign, a plastic cover and an interlock switch. No people.
shots.narration: 以及为此需要的种种安全措施。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现警示贴、联锁、闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside icons of a warning sign, an interlock and a lightning bolt.
shots.narration: 开盖联锁断高压，风扇还带电。

shots.scene: 护罩、紫色辉光、手停在线外三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a plastic cover, a purple glow and a hand stopping at a dotted line. No people.
shots.narration: 上万伏，致命很小，手不越过开口。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在合上盖子的机柜旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside the closed laser cabinet.
shots.narration: 敬畏高压电，下次见！
